name: Mate with king and queen
goal: You can mate a lone king with king and queen, pushing it to the edge without giving stalemate.
intro: Mating with king and queen against a lone king is easy once you know the method: use the queen alone to drive the enemy king to the edge of the board, keeping the queen a knight's move away from it, with no checks needed. Then bring your own king up to help, and watch out for stalemate. It takes about ten to fifteen moves.

parts.title: Drive the king to the edge
parts.text: First the queen works alone. Shrink the black king's space one rank or file at a time.
parts.line: Qb5 Ke6 Qc5 Kf6 Qd5 Kg6 Qe5 Kf7 Qd6 Kg7 Qe6 Kh7 Qg4 Kh6 Kb2

notes.text: Cut the black king off along the fifth rank.
Stay a knight's move away from the king. Checks like Qc6+ only give it more room.
The black king is now trapped on the edge, on the h-file.
Now that the king is stuck, your own king comes in to help finish the job.

parts.title: Finish the mate
parts.text: Your king has walked over to e5. Beware: Qg6 here would be stalemate, which is exactly what Black hopes for.

notes.text: Bring the king next to g7 so it can protect the queen there.
The queen, protected by the king, gives mate.
